question: what is your name?
answerTranslation: Me llamo Dana.

question: What is your lastname?
answerTranslation: Mi apellido es Rodríguez.

question: Where are you from?
answerTranslation: Soy de Guatemala.
reminder: Don't forget "from" and the name of the country

question: Where do you live?
answerTranslation: Vivo en la Ciudad de Guatemala.
reminder: Remember to use the preposition IN

question: How old are you?
answerTranslation: Tengo 19 años.
reminder: Use be to talk about age.

question: How are you? / How is it going? / How are you doing?
questionTranslation: ¿Cómo estás? / ¿Cómo te va? / ¿Cómo te está yendo?
answerTranslation: Estoy bien, gracias.
reminder: Also: I'm good; I'm pretty wgoo; I'm well. Everything is good, thank you!

question: What do you do?
answerTranslation: Soy estudiante.
reminder: Use a/an before the occupation.

question: What is your nationality?
answerTranslation: Soy guatemalteco/a.
reminder: Use verb to be + nationality (not country)

question: Can you spell your name?....  How do you spell your middle name?
questionTranslation: ¿Puedes deletrear tu nombre? .... ¿Cómo se deletrea tu segundo nombre?
answer: It is spelled M-A-R-I-A. It's spelled J-O-S-E
answerTranslation: Se deletrea M-A-R-I-A. Se deletrea J-O-S-E
reminder: Another form is: It is J O S E

question: What day is today?
answerTranslation: Hoy es lunes.
reminder: Use be to talk about dates and days.

question: When is your birthday?
answerTranslation: Mi cumpleaños es el 28 de noviembre.
reminder: Use ON for full dates

question: What is your favorite...?
answerTranslation: Mi comida favorita es la pizza.
reminder: don't use "The" for food (not "The" pizza)

question: What is your phone number?
answerTranslation: Mi número de teléfono es 5678-3456.
reminder: Give digits one by one

question: what is your email?
answerTranslation: Mi correo electrónico es dana@example.com.
reminder: Remember to use AT (@) DOT (.)

question: Who is your teacher?
answerTranslation: Mi profesora es Dana.
reminder: Use verb to be to identify people.

question: Who is your best friend?
answerTranslation: Mi mejor amigo es Sam.
reminder: Use verb to be to identify people.

question: Where is your house?
answerTranslation: Mi casa está en la Zona 5.
reminder: Use IN before zones cities and neighborhoods.

question: When is...?
answerTranslation: Es el 25 de diciembre.
reminder: Use ON before complete dates.

question: Why are you happy/tired/hungry?
answerTranslation: Porque estoy estudiando inglés.
reminder: Use BECAUSE to give reasons.

question: Where do you go grocery shopping?
answer: I go grocery shopping at La Torre.
answerTranslation: Hago las compras en La Torre.
reminder: Use GO + place.

question: What days do you go grocery shopping?
questionTranslation: ¿Qué días haces las compras del supermercado?
answer: I go grocery shopping on Sundays.
answerTranslation: Hago las compras los domingos.
reminder: Use ON with days of the week. Use S at the end of the day

question: What do you buy in the supermarket?
answer: I buy fruits vegetables and milk.
answerTranslation: Compro frutas verduras y leche.
reminder: You can mention different food items

question: Describe yourself using adjectives.
questionTranslation: Descríbete a tí mismo usando adjetivos
answer: I am an English student. I am a creative, determined and friendly person. I am also a little stubborn and impatient.
answerTranslation:
Soy una estudiante de inglés. Soy creativa, determinada y amigable.
También soy un poco terco e impaciente.
reminder:
Practice the pronunciation of your adjectives.
Use verb to be.
PRO TIP⭐Use "a little" or "a bit" for negative adjectives.

question: What is your favorite color?
answer: My favorite color is purple. ... My favorite colors ARE green and blue.
answerTranslation: Mi color favorito es el morado. ... Mis colores favoritos  SON el verde y azul.
reminder: Use ARE when using plural nouns

question: Who is your favorite actor or actress?
questionTranslation: Quién es tu actor o actriz favorito?
answer: My favorite actor is Brad Pitt. My favorite actress is Zendaya.
answerTranslation: My actor favorito es Brad Pitt. My actriz favorita es Zendaya.
reminder: You can subsittute "My favorite actor/actress" for "He is / She is". She is Zendaya

question: Who is your favorite singer?
answer: My favorite singer is Ricardo Arjona. She is Olivia Rodrigo.
answerTranslation: Mi cantante favorito es Ricardo Arjona. Es Olivia Rodrigo.
reminder: You can substitute "My favorite singer" for "He is / She is".

question: What kind of business would you like to have?
questionTranslation: ¿Qué tipo de negocio te gustaría tener?
answer: I would like to have a barber shop. I would love to have a law office.
answerTranslation: Me gustaría tener una barbería. Me encantaría tener una oficina de leyes.
reminder:
Would is pronounced ="wud"
Always use "to+verb" = I would love to have, I would like to own, I would prefer to have

question: Describe a famous person. Mention name, country of origin, nationality, age, and occupation.
questionTranslation: Describe a una persona famosa. Menciona su nombre, país de origen, nacionalidad, edad y ocupación.
answer: Shakira: Her full name is Shakira Isabel Mebarak. She is from Colombia; she is Colombian. She is 49 years old. She is a singer.
answerTranslation: Shakira: Su nombre completo es Shakira Isabel Mebarak. Es de Colombia; es colombiana. Tiene 49 años. Es cantante.
reminder:
Her= for women
His= for men

question: Describe a famous person. Mention artistic name, full name, country of origin, nationality, marital status, age, and occupation.
questionTranslation: Describe a una persona famosa. Menciona su nombre artístico, nombre completo, país de origen, nacionalidad, estado civil, edad y ocupación.
answer: Shakira: Her full name is Shakira Isabel Mebarak. Her artistic name is Shakira.  She is from Colombia; she is Colombian. She is 49 years old. She is a singer.
answerTranslation: Shakira: Su nombre completo es Shakira Isabel Mebarak. Su nombre artístico es Shakira. Es de Colombia; es colombiana. Tiene 49 años. Es cantante.
reminder: You can also say: She is best known by: Shakira. (Es mejor conocida como Shakira)

question: Where were you yesterday at 10:00 p.m.?
answer: I was at home watching TV.
answerTranslation: Estaba en casa viendo televisión.
reminder: Use WAS for I/he/she/it and WERE for you/we/they.

question: Who was your best friend when you were a child?
questionTranslation: ¿Quién era tu mejor amigo(a) cuando eras niño(a)?
answer: My best friend was Carlos when I was a child.
answerTranslation: Mi mejor amigo era Carlos cuando era niño.
reminder: Use WAS to describe people in the past.

question: What was your favorite TV show when you were a child?
questionTranslation: ¿Cuál era tu programa de televisión favorito cuando eras niño(a)?
answer: My favorite TV show was Tom and Jerry.
answerTranslation: Mi programa de televisión favorito era Tom y Jerry.
reminder: Use WAS to talk about favorites in the past.

question: What was your favorite show when you were a kid?
questionTranslation: ¿Cuál era tu programa favorito cuando eras niño(a)?
answer: My favorite show was SpongeBob SquarePants.
answerTranslation: Mi programa favorito era Bob Esponja.
reminder: Use WAS to talk about favorite shows from childhood.

question: What was your favorite movie when you were a kid?
questionTranslation: ¿Cuál era tu película favorita cuando eras niño(a)?
answer: My favorite movie was Toy Story.
answerTranslation: Mi película favorita era Toy Story.
reminder: Use WAS to talk about favorite movies in the past.

question: Where were you yesterday at 7 p.m.?
answer: I was at home having dinner.
answerTranslation: Estaba en casa cenando.
reminder: Use WAS/WERE to talk about locations in the past.

question: Where were you yesterday at 11 a.m.?
answerTranslation: Estaba en el trabajo.
reminder: Remember to use WAS/WERE when talking about the past.

question: What did you do yesterday?
answer: I worked, studied English, and relaxed at home.
answerTranslation: Trabajé, estudié inglés y descansé en casa.
reminder: Use the base verb after DID in questions.

question: What time did you wake up today?
answerTranslation: Me desperté a las 6:00 a.m.
reminder: Use the irregular verb WAKE → WOKE.

question: What time did your class start?
answerTranslation: Mi clase comenzó a las 8:00 a.m.
reminder: Regular verb: START → STARTED.

question: What did you do last weekend?
questionTranslation: ¿Qué hiciste el fin de semana pasado?
answer: I visited my family and watched movies.
answerTranslation: Visité a mi familia y vi películas.
reminder: Use simple past verbs to describe completed activities.

question: Where did you eat yesterday?
answer: I ate at a restaurant near my house.
answerTranslation: Comí en un restaurante cerca de mi casa.
reminder: Eat is irregular: EAT → ATE.

question: What time did you wake up yesterday?
answerTranslation: Me desperté a las 5:30 a.m.
reminder: Wake up is irregular: WAKE → WOKE.
